assessments.reasoning: The commit-pinned vixie/cron README opens with Paul Vixie’s copyright and terms on attribution, marking changes, preserving the notice and supplying buildable source on sale. The cited notice ends at the closing comment. The full 3,279-byte acquisition reports the digest in the claim scope. [Pinned Cron README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vixie/cron/545b3f5246824a9cda5905eeb7cf019c95e66995/README)

The committed Index decision lists prospective entity ac98abe54eec4a07af56b52a715622d5, corresponding to the claim subject with its e- prefix, under Vixie-Cron. It records Vixie Cron License, kind license, edition vixie-cron-captured-reference, revision sha256:b523dccfdbf14c0e2747faf8406f0bb8b953fb7647427c069aa90459369c0ac7 and lifecycle historical. [Committed Index decision](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/software-commons/license-index/acce97c2c5dbbf6228c02f95a5f43b5d20c0801e/docs/decisions/five-project-notices-lifecycle-2026-11-28.md)

challenge.method: Read the full pinned README and located the end of its opening comment. Checked the project repository and Paul Vixie attribution, then compared the acquired README digest and the claim’s entity, identifier, display name, kind, edition and lifecycle with the Vixie-Cron row.
challenge.results: The opening comment contains Vixie’s distribution conditions and warranty disclaimer. The V3.0 heading and dated release history follow the comment and identify the software. The row matches the claim and the acquired README digest, and assigns historical lookup status.

limitations: The lifecycle applies to lookup of the opening notice. The digest covers the complete README.
Other works, legal equivalence, reuse and installation require separate evidence.
Digest checks used the complete-range acquisition metadata. The four authorized acquisitions provide no separate verification of the policy commit or bundle hash.
reasoning: The project README supplies the notice and its scope. The Index decision supplies the display identity and historical classification for that exact captured representation.
